run_calc_localization_scores: run eval_calc_scores.py to calculate 6D object pose localization scores from pre-calculated errors
run_calc_detection_scores: run eval_calc_scores.py in detection mode to calculate 6D pose detection scores from errors
run_match_poses_scene: run eval_calc_scores.py to match estimated poses to ground-truth poses for a scene
run_normalize_errors_by_diameter: run eval_calc_scores.py to normalize pose errors by object diameter before thresholding
run_normalize_errors_by_im_width: run eval_calc_scores.py to normalize pose errors by image width before thresholding
